name: veterinary_clinic_system_018_boarding_overstay_flag
instruction: Guests still checked in past their scheduled check_out are overstays. For every reservation with status 'checked_in' whose check_out is strictly before the episode date, set status to 'overstay' and add overstay_days = <whole days between check_out and the episode date>. Reservations checking out exactly on the episode date are NOT overstays. Do not touch runs or other reservations.
